applies_to: TCW220 per the Teracom TCW220 user manual Revision R4.24, firmware V2.012 or later.
summary: The TCW220 is a Teracom Ethernet data logger with 2 analog inputs, 2 dry-contact inputs, 2 relays and a 1-Wire bus for up to 8 Teracom sensors. Over Modbus TCP it serves relays as coils, inputs as discrete inputs, and readings, limits and alarm flags as holding registers.

addressing.note: The address table prints PDU (wire) addresses in decimal. The manual's example frame reads register 19800 as 0x4D58 on the wire, so no offset is applied.

notes: Word order: the manual says float registers are sent big-endian and its example response 41BD 0655 decodes to 23.628, i.e. high word first (ABCD).
Strings are fixed-length UTF-8, zero padded; 64-byte fields span 32 registers.
1-Wire sensor values (S11..S82) are floats whose unit comes from the matching dimension string; each sensor has two value slots (Sx1, Sx2).

integration.summary: Enable Modbus TCP, then switch relays as coils 100-101, read inputs as discrete inputs 100-101 and read analog and 1-Wire floats from holding registers 17500+ and 19800+.
integration.enable: Modbus TCP/IP is disabled by default. Enable it on the services page of the web interface (standard port 502).
quirks: PDU 50000 reports whether settings are saved (0 = unsaved, 1 = saved).
setup: The factory IP is 192.168.1.2; change it in the network settings, then enable Modbus TCP/IP.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
